keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! PSV Eindhoven 0, Club Brugge 1. Nicolò Tresoldi (Club Brugge) header from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Joaquin Seys with a cross following a corner.
Carlos Forbs (Club Brugge) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Club Brugge. Félix Lemaréchal replaces Jan Virgili because of an injury.
Delay in match because of an injury Ivan Perisic (PSV Eindhoven).
Delay in match because of an injury Freddie Potts (Club Brugge).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, PSV Eindhoven 0, Club Brugge 1.
Goal! PSV Eindhoven 1, Club Brugge 1. Kodai Sano (PSV Eindhoven) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Joaquin Seys (Club Brugge).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! PSV Eindhoven 1, Club Brugge 2. Carlos Forbs (Club Brugge) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Joaquin Seys following a fast break.
Substitution, PSV Eindhoven. Ricardo Pepi replaces Ruben van Bommel.
Hugo Vetlesen (Club Brugge) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Jorne Spileers (Club Brugge) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Club Brugge. Romeo Vermant replaces Nicolò Tresoldi.
Substitution, Club Brugge. Mamadou Diakhon replaces Hugo Vetlesen.
Substitution, PSV Eindhoven. Esmir Bajraktarevic replaces Filip Kostic.
Substitution, Club Brugge. Hugo Siquet replaces Carlos Forbs.
Substitution, PSV Eindhoven. Mikkel Hansen replaces Sven Mijnans.
